description: Call any Instagram endpoint from list_endpoints by its path under /v1/instagram/. This reaches everything Instagram offers, including what the capability tools above do not wrap; a path on another platform is refused. Pass only the parameters that endpoint accepts; list_endpoints reports which one it needs.

fields.description: Comma-separated field projection, to trim the response.

fresh.description: Bypass the cache. Same credit cost, slower.

handle.description: For endpoints whose input is a handle. Usually an account handle without the @; list_endpoints reports handle_is on the endpoints where it identifies something else.

include_email.description: Only on endpoints that price an email separately.

limit.description: Items to return on list endpoints, up to 50; a larger value is lowered to 50. Charged per item returned, and an empty result is free (25 a day per account, then 1 credit each).

path.description: Endpoint path exactly as list_endpoints reports it, starting with /v1/instagram/.

url.description: For endpoints whose input is a URL.

name: call_endpoint

data.description: The endpoint's payload: one object, or an array for list calls.

meta.description: count, limit and next_cursor on list calls; credits_charged, credits_remaining and cache (hit or miss) on billed calls; limit_clamped when fewer items were requested upstream than the balance could cover; limit_capped when a free account's request was lowered to the free tier's 5-item ceiling.

summary: Run any Instagram endpoint by its path, so nothing Instagram offers is out of reach of an agent.
title: Call any Instagram endpoint by path
